title: Clockwork Pop - Playtest Conversion

assets.name: Pepperbox Watchman
assets.notes: Clear aiming head and muzzle bores. Preserve the favourite silhouette; separate the fixed base from the yawing head.

assets.name: Kilnheart Lobber
assets.notes: Compact heavy body and short wide muzzle. Add a clear yaw joint above the planted supports. Variant 1 is the longer-barrel alternate; variant 3 the more ornate alternate.

assets.name: Tuning-Fork Conductor
assets.notes: Strong fork silhouette. Model solid electrode tips instead of the hollow-looking bores. Place the emission origin between the prongs.

assets.name: Resonance Bell
assets.notes: Simple radial bell, brass hoop and amber crown. Keep pulse effects in the game rather than the mesh.

assets.name: Dugout Automaton
assets.notes: Bat is held near its butt knob, with 84% of the length beyond the grip. Visible reach scales with actual attack range; fixed base stays planted.

assets.name: Bramble Wisp
assets.notes: Broad leaf-like armour gives a distinctive bramble silhouette. Variant 3 is the more mechanical alternate. Use simple hover motion before articulating every thorn.

assets.name: Skipper Moth
assets.notes: Clean mint wings with mirrored hinge motion and a readable hover silhouette. Texture loops and reversed surface winding corrected.

assets.name: Bulwark Hermit
assets.notes: Six separate root hip pivots under a heavy brass-banded dome. Mirrored lift and stride checked; rounded feet simplify the concept.

assets.name: Ramjet Beetle
assets.notes: Four root hip pivots, coral shell, teal visor and forward brass tusks. Imported stride and existing wind-up/dash behavior pass.

assets.name: Pip the Lantern Keeper
assets.notes: Independent torso aiming with separate hip pivots, planted-foot clearance and pistol recoil. Helmet and boots are simplified from the concept.

assets.name: Keepsake Cache
assets.notes: Clean box, readable latch and lid seam. Model the cream top as a solid inset lid.

assets.name: Cinder Puffer
assets.notes: User authorized agent selection. Capped teal top variant1; coral pressure vessel, brass plugs, orange-red glass eye.

assets.name: Clockwork Gyroscope Core
assets.notes: Created directly in 3D: teal/brass gyroscope with three independently rotating rings around a procedural plasma orb. Collision remains 1.1 m; health tint, destruction and reduced motion handled by the runtime.

events.text: 12 selected concepts. User approved Cinder Puffer variant1. Original assets preserved. Completion requires visual review, correct attack/movement behavior, gameplay integration, tests and uncontended performance comparison.
Sol high asset agents started Keepsake Cache, Pepperbox Watchman and Bramble Wisp. All remaining reference files and pivot briefs prepared.

Original game: all 846 tests passed with no risky tests, unexpected errors or remaining orphans. No new models integrated yet. Baseline performance will be captured when no Blender rendering competes for GPU.

Returned to generator for correction; not accepted or promoted. Pepperbox iteration1 exposed a texture-buffer issue; generator is repairing it and reducing accessory tessellation.

events.stage: Full roster integration and measured performance
events.text: Promoted Bulwark Hermit iteration3 and Ramjet Beetle iteration3. Reviewed final imported motion poses and gameplay-scale capture. Corrected mirrored forward stride direction and updated the legacy-tint test to preserve authored moth colors. All 857 tests pass with the full roster. Repeated mixed-crowd benchmarks recorded alongside the original family; animated Clockwork medians 15.3–15.5 ms, p95 21.5–22.4 ms on RTX4090. No further geometry reduction justified by this measurement.

Normal main scene launches without errors. Application capture checks Play, settings, pause, defeat, victory and return to menu. Six-wave automated progression wins with 342 kills and no defeat; this verifies the game loop, not human balance or input feel. HTML report reviewed in browser, including the pose scrubber. All twelve assets verified; originals retained. Remaining playtest judgments: cache size, crowded silhouettes, and motion feel. Minimum-spec performance and larger crowds remain unmeasured.

Merged the roster into master. Added saved Off / Contextual / All ground-marker preference, default Contextual. Routine enemy and player rings are hidden; special threats retain their cue. Entrench shows during nearby inspection and for 0.65 seconds on stack gain, without changing bonuses. Core clearance shows while carrying a turret. Build zones, attack warnings, slow status and combat effects stay visible. Full suite: 860 tests pass; saved-preference round-trip and invalid values checked separately. Settings and gameplay captures reviewed.

Camera was smoothing in render frames while the hero moved on physics ticks. Moved camera advance to physics processing at priority100, after player movement. A rendered constant-motion probe at 120 FPS reproduced 120 backward screen steps and a 4.89px oscillation before the change; afterward, 120 and 144 FPS checks show zero backward steps and zero ground-anchor oscillation. All nine camera tests (326 assertions) pass, including zoom and arena bounds. Intentional walking animation remains.

Follow-up to enemy vibration: enabled scoped physics interpolation for actors, pickups and camera, keeping idle effects/build-zone animation separate. Reset histories for spawns, pooled projectiles, dissolves, camera snaps and carried turret placement. At 144 render FPS, an enemy held its rendered position on 167/288 sampled frames before interpolation and zero afterward. Hero rendered-anchor oscillation stays below 0.001px. The 10Hz physics stress check also passes. Full suite: 863 tests pass.

Replaced tubular rings with antialiased flat floor dials. Build zones have dashed pending outlines, fixed-radius tier-colored boundaries, cardinal alignment marks and an inner progress arc. Entrenchment uses compact amber stack segments with partial next-stack progress. Removed radius wobble; occupied zones get only a restrained brightness pulse, disabled with Reduced motion. Existing Off/Contextual/All behavior and gameplay radii/bonuses are preserved. In-game state preview reviewed; all 863 tests pass.

Created directly in 3D at user request; one reviewed generation iteration. 21,176 triangles, 5 meshes, 7 materials; no bitmap textures. Three independently rotating rings and a procedural plasma orb replace the core in core/convoy modes. Health tint, destruction, reduced motion and physics interpolation are supported; original collision/repair rules remain. Reviewed close, rotated, gameplay, critical and destroyed Godot captures. All 865 tests pass; resource audit passes 170 sources/25 model records. No performance benchmark was run for this singleton.

performance.method: Godot 4.7.1 Forward+, RTX 4090, 1280×720, VSync off. Two runs per setting, each with a 2-second warm-up and 10-second sample. Fixed crowd: 30 of each of five enemy types, one cache, hero and 12 turrets. Rendering jobs and tests stopped for benchmarks; timings are local development measurements.
performance.interpretation: The animated roster is suitable for playtesting on this machine, with lower median/p95 frame times than the original set in this scene. It is not a locked 60 FPS guarantee: tail frames exceed 16.7 ms, and minimum-spec hardware is untested. Reduced motion also disables other cosmetic effects, so its difference is not an isolated animation cost. Snapshot draw calls: about 800–802 vs 684 original; follow up with profiling before increasing crowd size.

launch: On branch master, run pwsh -File .\turret-game\launch.ps1 from the monorepo root and choose PLAY. The twelve converted assets and the new gyroscope core are active by default; choose Protect Core or Convoy to see the core. Settings → Reduced motion disables cosmetic movement. Original models remain available with the Godot user argument --legacy-assets for comparisons. Human playtesting is the next step.
